name: js-word-wrap
instruction: Implement wordWrap.js (CommonJS): module.exports = wordWrap. wordWrap(text, width) greedily wraps text so no output line exceeds `width` characters. Words are separated by runs of spaces, which collapse to a single space inside a line. An existing '\n' in the input is a HARD break that is preserved, and an empty line stays empty. A word longer than `width` is NOT split - it goes on a line of its own and may exceed the width. Output lines never have leading or trailing spaces. width must be a positive integer or an Error is thrown.
